[[PT10]] (POKÉTOON) |enva=[[Lizzie Freeman]] (Series) |jpva=Ayana Taketatsu (Series) }} {{Character Infobox/Manga |color={{contest color light}} |series=''[[Pokémon Adventures]]'' |debut=''[[PS596|Metagross Investigates]]'' }} |} '''Lisia''' (Japanese: '''ルチア''' ''Lutia'') is a [[non-player character]] in [[Pokémon Omega Ruby and Alpha Sapphire]]. She is a [[Pokémon Coordinator]] from [[Sootopolis City]] and the niece of [[Wallace]]. For her achievements in {{pkmn|Contest|Pokémon Contest Spectaculars}}, she became an {{wp|Japanese idol|idol}} in [[Hoenn]], filming commercials and scouting {{pkmn|Trainer}}s to participate in contests. ==In the core series games== Lisia is the number one Contest star in [[Hoenn]] with a huge fanbase. She owns an {{p|Altaria}} [[nickname]]d '''Ali''' (Japanese: '''チルル''' ''Tylulu''), which she has owned since he was a {{p|Swablu}}. She can [[Mega Evolution|Mega Evolve]] him into Mega Altaria using her [[Key Stone|Mega Tiara]]. Some of her fans call her "Lissi" (Japanese: '''ルッチー''' ''Lutti''). Her fanbase has their own {{pkmn|Fan Club|clubhouse}}, which is located in [[Lilycove City]]. She is the daughter of [[Wallace]]'s older sister and through her family she is a descendant of the ancient people of [[Sootopolis City]]. Although she is originally from Sootopolis City, she does not live there anymore. She decided to try doing Contests after seeing her uncle perform in them and then became a Contest star almost overnight. She quickly became a bigger star than Wallace, which allowed Wallace to put more focus on his position of [[Gym Leader]]. Her motivation to do Contests is so that she can show people that there is more to Pokémon than just {{pkmn|battle|battling}}. [[File:Lisia ORAS.png|thumb|left|240px|Lisia in Slateport City]] She learned everything about Contests from Wallace and considers him to be her mentor. She is good friends with {{ga|Chaz}}, a fellow {{pkmn|Coordinator}} who debuted in Contests the same day as Lisia did. Chaz admires Lisia a great deal and considers her a [[rival]] of his, something which Lisia does not like, as she does not believe Contests are about rivalry. She scouts the {{player}} as a potential Contest star after spotting them in a crowd in front of the [[Slateport City]] [[Contest Hall]], giving them a [[Contest Pass]] and a [[Pokéblock Kit]]. She has scouted a lot of {{pkmn|Trainer}}s and a great deal of them have become Contest stars. She claims the player is the hundredth Trainer she scouted. When the player talks to the receptionist in any Contest Hall for the first time, she approaches them and gives the player a [[Contest Costume]]. According to Wallace, Lisia was brought to a safe place when {{p|Groudon}}{{sup/6|OR}}/{{p|Kyogre}}{{sup/6|AS}} was wreaking havoc throughout [[Hoenn]]. She occasionally appears to talk with the player in the dressing room of a Contest Hall. She will appear each first time the player has won a Contest of each {{OBP|rank|Contest}}, after the player beats all five Master Rank Contests and after the player beats her in a Contest. Lisia will occasionally enter Contests after the player has beaten all five Master Rank Contests. After the player has beaten Lisia, she will present them with a Star Light [[decoration]] for their [[Secret Base]]. {{left clear}} ===Pokémon=== {{Pokémon/Grid}} {{Pokémon/Contest | caption = {{color2|000|Pokémon Omega Ruby and Alpha Sapphire|Omega Ruby and Alpha Sapphire}} |} ==Quotes== {{main|Lisia/Quotes}} ==In animation== ===''Pokémon the Series''=== [[File:Lisia anime.png|thumb|250px|Lisia in {{aniseries|JN}}]] [[File:Lisia Wallace Journeys.png|left|thumb|250px|Wallace and Lisia]] Lisia debuted in ''[[JN105|Reuniting for the First Time!]]''. She first appeared in front of the [[Lilycove City]] [[Contest Hall]] to scout a person for the upcoming {{pkmn|Contest|Pokémon Contest Spectacular}}. She ended up choosing [[Chloe]], despite her reluctance, giving her a [[Contest Pass]] and a [[Pokéblock Case]]. When Chloe later met {{an|Serena}}, she told Chloe that she and Lisia had been working together to liven up Contests in [[Hoenn]]. Later, Lisia participated in a {{OBP|Rank|Contest|Master Rank}} Contest Spectacular at Lilycove. She and Serena eventually tied with the first place, and she suggested that they should team up and become an idol duo together, to which Serena was hesitant of the idea at the time. In ''[[JN132|Partners in Time!]]'', Lisia appeared alongside {{an|May}}, [[Max]], and Serena, watching {{Ash}}'s [[Masters Eight Tournament]] match against {{an|Leon}}. ====Pokémon==== This listing is of Lisia's known {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} in {{aniseries|PTS}}: {{left clear}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Lisia |nick=Ali |mega=yes |pkmn=Altaria |type1=Dragon |type2=Flying |img=Lisia Ali.png |cap=Ali |img2=Lisia Ali Mega Altaria.png |cap2=Ali as a Mega Altaria |epnum=JN105 |epname=Reuniting for the First Time! |vajp=Ikue Otani |vaen= |desc={{p|Altaria|Ali}} (Japanese: '''チルル''' ''Tylulu'') is Lisia's signature Pokémon, who is capable of [[Mega Evolution|Mega Evolving]]. Ali's known moves are {{m|Mist}} and {{m|Draco Meteor}}.}} ====Contests==== =====Hoenn Ribbons===== This listing is of the [[Ribbon]]s Lisia has obtained in the [[Hoenn]] [[region]]: * {{ci|Lilycove}} Ribbon (Master Rank; tied with {{an|Serena}}; ''[[JN105|Reuniting for the First Time!]]'') ====Voice actors==== {{vatable|color={{contest color light}}|bordercolor={{contest color}} |ja=竹達 彩奈 ''Ayana Taketatsu'' |en=Lizzie Freeman |da=Rebekka Philipson |fr_eu=Leïla Devin |he=נוגה טבצ'ניקוב ''Noga Tabachnikov'' |pt_br=Amanda Brigido |es_eu=Lucía San Román}} ===POKÉTOON=== [[File:Lisia POKÉTOON.png|250px|thumb|Lisia in [[POKÉTOON]]]] Lisia appeared in a cameo in [[PT10]] as the star of a live show that the [[Boy (PT10)|protagonist]] and his {{p|Primeape}} went to watch. {{-}} ==In the manga== [[File:Lisia Chaz Adventures.png|thumb|220px|Lisia in Pokémon Adventures]] ===Pokémon Adventures=== Lisia first appeared in ''[[PS596|Metagross Investigates]]'', where she was seen on a live [[Television|TV broadcast]] with {{adv|Ruby}} at the {{ci|Rustboro}} TV Station. Afterward, in Slateport City, Lisia excitedly praises Ruby and the various ideas he had created for Pokémon Contests while Chaz begrudgingly listens. After getting tired of hearing about Ruby, Chaz decides to leave only for Lisia to stop him. Lisia reveals that after the broadcast, she overheard Ruby stating that it might be the last time he participates in a Pokémon Contest. When Chaz assumes Ruby might just be going to find better Contests in other regions, Lisia is angered and assumes he means Ruby must be quitting. She then goes to call [[Wallace|her uncle]] to complain about Chaz. Later, Lisia travels to [[Sootopolis City]] in order to help in destroying a [[Grand Meteor Delta|meteoroid]] threatening to destroy the world. When she arrives, Lisia hands Ruby a pair of [[Contest Costume]]s for him and {{adv|Sapphire}} to wear. ====Pokémon==== =====On hand===== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Lisia |pkmn=Altaria |nick=Ali |type1=Dragon |type2=Flying |img=Lisia Ali Adventures.png |epnum=PS596 |epname=Metagross Investigates |desc={{p|Altaria|Ali}} is Lisia's only known {{OBP|Pokémon|species}}.
